name: Music library
sub: Repertoire, scores and part assignments, searchable, with digital parts and practice recordings for students if you want them.
get: Assign parts and check out music by student, so you know who has which folder.
Recordings play inside Program Partner instead of as files passed around, and only the students you share them with can hear them.
cta: Bring your library catalog, however messy it is.

faq.q: Do I have to use digital parts?
faq.a: No. They stay off until you turn them on.

steps.body: Import your catalog from a spreadsheet, or have us import it. Then assign parts to students.

steps.body: If you choose, share PDF parts and practice recordings with the students playing each piece.
